records.raw_html:
Worked example 8.3: Addition in the base two number system (Method 2)

Find the sum of and .

  1. Step 1: Write the numbers one below the other, without the subscript "two". Line up the units ( ), twos ( ), fours ( ) and eights ( ).

  2. Step 2: Add the units in the base two number system. If the answer is 10 or 11, carry over the left-hand 1 and write down the right-hand 0 or 1.

    Remember to use and .

  3. Step 3: Repeat Step 2 for the twos ( ) column.

  4. Step 4: Repeat Step 3 for the fours ( ) column.

  5. Step 5: Bring down the one that was carried over to the eights ( ) column.

    The answer is .

  6. Step 6: Check your answer using the base ten number system.

    The answer is correct.
records.answer_text:
Step 1: Write the numbers one below the other, without the subscript "two". Line up the units ($2^0$), twos ($2^1$), fours ($2^2$) and eights ($2^3$).

$$
\ egin{array}{r r}
 & \color{blue}{2^3 \, 2^2 \, 2^1 \, 2^0 }\\
 & 1\;\;0\;\;1\;\, \\
 +& 1\;\;1\;\;1\;\, \\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Step 2: Add the units in the base two number system. If the answer is 10 or 11, carry over the left-hand 1 and write down the right-hand 0 or 1.

Remember to use $1+1=10$ and $1+1+1=11$.

$$
\ egin{array}{r r}
 & \color{blue}{2^3 \, 2^2 \, 2^1 \, 2^0 }\\
 &_{1} \phantom{000}\\
 & 1\;\;0\;\;1\;\, \\
 +& 1\;\;1\;\;1\;\, \\
 \hline
 & 0\;\, \\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Step 3: Repeat Step 2 for the twos ($2^1$) column.

$$1+1=10$$

$$
\ egin{array}{r r}
 & \color{blue}{2^3 \, 2^2 \, 2^1 \, 2^0 }\\
 &_{1}\;\;_{1} \phantom{000}\\
 & 1\;\;0\;\;1\;\, \\
 +& 1\;\;1\;\;1\;\, \\
 \hline
 & 0\;\;0\;\, \\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Step 4: Repeat Step 3 for the fours ($2^2$) column.

$$1+1+1=11$$

$$
\ egin{array}{r r}
 & \color{blue}{2^3 \, 2^2 \, 2^1 \, 2^0 }\\
 &_{1}\;\;_{1}\;\;_{1} \phantom{000}\\
 & 1\;\;0\;\;1\;\, \\
 +& 1\;\;1\;\;1\;\, \\
 \hline
 & 1\;\;0\;\;0\;\, \\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

Step 5: Bring down the one that was carried over to the eights ($2^3$) column.

$$
\ egin{array}{r r}
 & \color{blue}{2^3 \, 2^2 \, 2^1 \, 2^0 }\\
 &_{1}\;\;_{1}\;\;_{1} \phantom{000}\\
 & 1\;\;0\;\;1\;\, \\
 +& 1\;\;1\;\;1\;\, \\
 \hline
 &1\;\; 1\;\;0\;\;0\;\, \\
 \hline
 \end{array}
$$

The answer is $1100_\text{two}$.

Step 6: Check your answer using the base ten number system.

$$
\ egin{align}
101_2&=2^2+0+2^0 \\
&=4+1 \\
&=5_{10}\\
\end{align}
$$
$$\quad$$
$$
\ egin{align}
111_2&=2^2+2^1+2^0 \\
&=4+2+1 \\
&=7_{10}\\
\end{align}
$$
$$\quad$$
$$5+7=12$$
$$\quad$$
$$
\ egin{align}
12_{10}&=8+4 \\
&=2^3+2^2+0+0 \\
&=1100_2\\
\end{align}
$$

The answer is correct.
